**Finding submitted: deviation on TRANSITION (§ 11).**

- **Problem:** § 11.1 (p0045) mandated immediate cessation of all assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export — walk-away territory — and directly contradicted § 11.2 (30-day machine-readable return) and § 11.3 (deletion plus officer certification after confirmed return). No transition assistance period exists anywhere in the document (§ 10.1 only references "any agreed transition period"), so even the 90-day fallback failed; § 11.2's 30-day clock also ran from Customer's request rather than expiry/termination.
- **Cure (preferred level, two surgical replaces):** § 11.1 now grants up to six (6) months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates on expiry or termination; § 11.2's clock is anchored to "expiry, termination, or Customer's request" with all remaining wording untouched.
- **Already met and not re-drafted:** machine-readable return format (§ 11.2) and certified deletion after return (§ 11.3).
